report.summary: Orders cannot be placed because CheckoutService/PlaceOrder fails whenever its downstream call to PaymentService/Charge fails. In the last hour of the authorized window the checkout PlaceOrder server span recorded 18.305 error spans and checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge recorded the identical 18.305 failures with gRPC status 2 (Unknown); the same count appears on the frontend client span, frontend POST/api route (HTTP 500), frontend-proxy ingress and load-generator POST, i.e. one failed order per failed charge. A captured failing trace shows the error text originates inside the payment service: 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' thrown at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13), propagated to checkout as 'failed to charge card ... rpc error: code = Unknown' (gRPC 13) and to the user as HTTP 500. Payment Charge errors were exactly 0 in all 23 preceding hourly windows sampled, while payment charge traffic was unchanged (76.3-108.8 no-status spans/hour before vs 77.288 in the incident hour), so this is a new, payment-side application failure rather than a checkout fault, a dependency outage or increased load. Roughly 19% of charge attempts failed (18.305 of ~95.6 attempts), and payment's own transaction counter shows ~74.2 completed charge transactions in the hour, consistent with a partial, targeted rejection. The exact trigger (a payment-service fault-injection / feature-flag rule targeting app.loyalty.level=gold) is a hypothesis: no flag-provider configuration or change record is present in the telemetry I could read.

claims.text: In the hour 2026-10-14T19:24:33Z-20:24:33Z, checkout's server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder recorded 18.305 error spans alongside 77.288 spans carrying no status, and checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge recorded the same 18.305 error spans; every other checkout client span (GetCart, Convert, GetProduct, GetQuote, ShipOrder) recorded 0 errors.

checkout's outbound gRPC calls to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge failed with rpc_grpc_status_code=2 (18.305 calls in the hour), while its calls to CurrencyService/Convert (266.44), CartService/GetCart (95.59), CartService/EmptyCart (77.29), ShippingService/GetQuote and ShipOrder, and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (170.85) all returned rpc_grpc_status_code=0.

The failure originates inside the payment service: payment's server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service_version 2.0.2) carries grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and an exception at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13); checkout propagated the same text as 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (rpc.grpc.status_code 13), and frontend returned HTTP 500 to the load generator.

Payment Charge failures are new in this hour: the hourly increase of payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge error spans was 0 in each of the 23 preceding hourly windows sampled (2026-10-13T21:24:33Z through 2026-10-14T19:24:33Z) and 18.305 in the final hour, while the no-status charge span count was 76.27-108.81 per hour before the incident and 77.288 during it.

At 5-minute resolution the checkout PlaceOrder error increase was 0 for every bucket up to and including the window ending 19:59:33Z, then 5 (ending 20:04:33Z), 10 (20:09:33Z), 1.25 (20:14:33Z), 0 (20:19:33Z) and 3.75 (20:24:33Z), so the failures began around 19:59-20:04Z and were still occurring at the end of the window.

The error count is identical (18.305) on load-generator POST spans, frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress', frontend 'POST' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder client span, so each failing charge corresponds to one user-visible failed order; frontend's PlaceOrder client span shows 18.305 errors versus 77.288 spans with no status in the same hour.

Payment still completed charges during the same hour: app_payment_transactions_total increased by 68.13 (CAD) and 6.10 (USD), about 74.2 transactions, against 18.305 failed charge attempts, and all of these series carry the single pod payment-6f7bc865d6-bfxbv in namespace otel-demo.

flagd shows chronic error activity unrelated to the incident: flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream error spans were 6.10-10.17 per hour in every one of the 24 hourly windows of the authorized period, including all baseline hours when payment charge errors were 0.

Most likely cause: a payment-service-side condition that rejects charge requests carrying app.loyalty.level=gold (a targeted failure-injection / feature-flag path inside payment), not a checkout defect. The payment handler answers quickly with an application error whose text embeds that targeting attribute, and only about 19% of charge attempts fail (18.305 of ~95.6), which is the shape of a tier-scoped rule rather than a global outage.

The failing requests are concentrated in the gold loyalty tier because the payment service records the flag-targeting context (app.loyalty.level) in the thrown error and the failing share (~19%) resembles a subset of the load rather than all traffic; this is inferred from a single captured failing trace plus aggregate counts, so it needs confirmation from the request mix and from the payment configuration.

A flagd (feature-flag provider) outage is not supported as the cause: flagd EventStream error spans ran at 6.10-10.17 per hour across the whole 24-hour period including the error-free baseline hours, so they do not track the incident; conversely payment's own flag-evaluation spans were few (3.05 ResolveFloat and 3.05 flagSync spans in the incident hour) and not error-flagged.

A collapse in payment traffic or a payment outage does not fit the data: the no-status charge span count during the incident hour (77.288) sits inside the pre-incident range (76.27-108.81 per hour), and ~74.2 charge transactions completed in the same hour, so most charges still succeed.

Rejected: a failing checkout dependency other than payment. In the captured failed order, cart GetCart, currency Convert (5 calls), product-catalog GetProduct (4 calls) and shipping GetQuote all returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and checkout's error metrics show errors only on PlaceOrder and PaymentService/Charge.

Rejected: payment being unreachable, hung or overloaded. The failing Charge span completed in 3939 us and returned an application-level gRPC Unknown (code 2) error message generated by payment's own charge handler, not a timeout or Unavailable status.

gaps: No evidence of feature-flag configuration, targeting rules or a flag-state change was available; flagd flag values and configurations are not exposed by the metrics or trace views read, so the flag-driven/targeted-failure trigger remains an unverified hypothesis.

Only one failing order trace could be captured (one payment trace, span_groups incomplete: 'backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist'); it is unverified that all 18.305 failing charge attempts carry the same 'Invalid token' message or that all failed orders are gold-tier.
A traces_search for payment over 2026-10-14T20:19:33Z-20:21:33Z returned status no_data (0 traces), so payment trace coverage in the final minutes is unknown rather than empty.
No comparable pre-incident latency baseline was established for payment Charge duration, so no latency trend or latency-based cause can be claimed.
Attribution is limited to span/service labels available in the metric series (service_name, span_name, status_code); per-pod or per-request-attribute breakdowns of the failures could not be derived.
next_steps: Have a human inspect the payment service's feature-flag provider state (and its targeting rules, e.g. loyalty-level based rules) and any recent flag or configuration changes around 19:59Z on 2026-10-14.
Check the load generator's request mix to confirm the share of gold-tier requests matches the observed ~19% failure share of charge attempts.
Review payment pod logs for payment-6f7bc865d6-bfxbv around 2026-10-14T19:59Z-20:24:33Z for the charge.js charge-path failures and the token/loyalty-level context they carry.
